acceptance_criteria: No authority link is inferred solely from a later narrative assertion.
Every required authority object has an exact predecessor, byte identity, verification state, commit state, publication state, and effectiveness state.
remediation_tracks.name: AUTHORITY_AND_D0301_PROVENANCE_CLOSURE
remediation_tracks.objective: Establish an independently verifiable object-level authority, effectiveness, publication, activation, and one-shot-consumption chain for the governance objects required by the pre-C4 boundary, without replaying D0301.
required_future_evidence: Exact byte identities and Git object identities for each authority-bearing predecessor object.
Independent verification evidence for each object whose effectiveness was conditional on verification.
Commit identity and publication evidence for each object whose effectiveness required commit and publication.
Activation/effectiveness evidence demonstrating that required conditions were satisfied before dependent execution.
D0301 publication evidence.
D0301 single-successful-execution consumption evidence.
Explicit non-replay record for D0301.

acceptance_criteria: No positional index may be silently treated as an AEA02 property path.
Every accepted mapping has deterministic provenance and exact namespace typing.
Ambiguous or unsupported mappings remain UNRESOLVED.
The global C-rule is independently frozen before any execution using it.
remediation_tracks.name: GLOBAL_C_RULE_AND_NAMESPACE_CROSSWALK_FREEZE
remediation_tracks.objective: Define and independently freeze one normative global C-rule plus an exact typed namespace/crosswalk contract that prevents positional indices, candidate identifiers, and schema property paths from being conflated.
required_future_evidence: Normative global C-rule identifier and exact immutable bytes.
Rule input domain, output domain, precedence semantics, conflict semantics, unresolved semantics, and fail-closed behavior.
Explicit namespace definitions for every identifier class used by the closure chain.
Typed source-to-target crosswalk rows with provenance.
Explicit distinction between post-C3 candidate indices and AEA02 schema_v2_property_path identifiers.
Independent verification, freeze, commit, publication, and activation evidence for the rule/crosswalk package before downstream use.

acceptance_criteria: No missing evidence is converted into negative proof.
No carrier-admissibility status is converted into Req06/Req14 satisfaction.
No candidate is dropped to obtain zero unresolved status.
All required reconciliation relations are accounted for explicitly.
remediation_tracks.name: CANDIDATE_TO_REQUIREMENT_RECONCILIATION
remediation_tracks.objective: Create an explicit governed reconciliation between the authoritative candidate universe and Req06/Req14 applicability or satisfaction evidence without converting carrier closure or missing evidence into requirement satisfaction or negative proof.
required_future_evidence: Exact authoritative candidate-universe binding.
Explicit requirement applicability relation for every relation that is actually required by the governing specification.
Provenance for every Req06 or Req14 determination.
Explicit UNRESOLVED state where governed evidence is insufficient.
Explicit NOT_APPLICABLE only when supported by governed evidence rather than omission.

acceptance_criteria: Zero unresolved required C4 closure relations.
No relation synthesized from absence of evidence.
Independent verification completed after closure execution.
C4 remains unauthorized until a separate post-verification authorization transaction.
remediation_tracks.name: EXPLICIT_C4_WITNESS_CLOSURE
remediation_tracks.objective: Establish explicit candidate-to-C4-criterion witness relations under the frozen rule, namespace, authority, and requirement-reconciliation state, with zero unresolved required closure relations before any C4 authorization is considered.
required_future_evidence: Exact frozen C4 relation target.
Explicit witness or governed relation for every required closure item.
Deterministic provenance from candidate identity through the applicable rule/crosswalk/reconciliation state to the C4 relation.
Explicit unresolved accounting.
Independent verification of the complete closure result.
